strings.DEC_SMUTA_ARMS_SMUGGLING_DESC: A steady flow of surplus Wehrmacht carbines and American Garands pours across porous borders. Acquire illicit armaments for frontline shock brigades.
strings.DEC_SMUTA_ARMS_SMUGGLING_LOG: Smuggled arms cache delivered to frontline divisions: +3,000 rifles!
strings.DEC_SMUTA_SHOCK_RECRUITMENT_DESC: Rally patriotic youth and former Red Army veterans under the banner of Russian reunification. Expedited mobilization of volunteer shock detachments.
strings.DEC_SMUTA_SHOCK_RECRUITMENT_LOG: Mobilization depots operational: +7,500 personnel added to reserves!
strings.DEC_SMUTA_RADIO_BROADCAST_DESC: Transmit ideological appeals across radio relay towers into rival warlord territories. Undermine enemy garrison morale and bolster popular legitimacy.
strings.DEC_SMUTA_RADIO_BROADCAST_LOG: Propaganda broadcasts sowed dissent in hostile rear lines: Legitimacy +6%, Unrest -4%!
strings.DEC_SMUTA_INFILTRATE_CACHES_TITLE: Night Raid on Fuel & Munition Depots
strings.DEC_SMUTA_INFILTRATE_CACHES_DESC: Infiltrate deep reconnaissance teams behind rival warlord lines to detonate fuel reserves and seize artillery caches.
strings.DEC_SMUTA_INFILTRATE_CACHES_LOG: Sabotage raid was an unconditional success: Depots neutralized, 80 heavy equipment units captured!
strings.DEC_SMUTA_GRAIN_REQUISITION_DESC: Compulsorily requisition surplus grain and supplies from rural artels to sustain combat garrisons in field conditions.
strings.DEC_SMUTA_GRAIN_REQUISITION_LOG: Grain levies replenished frontline storehouses: Reserves +$40M, +1,500 recruits!
strings.DEC_SMUTA_VETERAN_OFFICER_RALLY_DESC: Grant amnesty and commission veteran commanders from defunct formations to reorganize tactical command and conduct field exercises.
strings.DEC_SMUTA_VETERAN_OFFICER_RALLY_LOG: Experienced officers took command of battalions: Readiness +10%, War Support +5%!
strings.DEC_REICH_INSPECT_ARSENALS_DESC: Audit OKW ordnance depots and secure allegiances of wavering senior officers ahead of the looming civil war.
strings.DEC_REICH_INSPECT_ARSENALS_LOG: Inspection concluded: Garrison divisions placed on high alert (+8% readiness)!
strings.DEC_REICH_SUBSIDIZE_CARTELS_DESC: Grant favorable state credit lines to Krupp and Siemens in exchange for priority tank shipments and boardroom loyalty.
strings.DEC_REICH_SUBSIDIZE_CARTELS_LOG: Cartels signed covert pacts: GDP +$0.6B, Military Factories +2!
strings.DEC_REICH_PRESS_CRACKDOWN_DESC: Suppress defeatist rhetoric and purge unreliable editors across Berlin daily publications.
strings.DEC_REICH_PRESS_CRACKDOWN_LOG: Censorship tightened: Defeatism crushed (Radicalization -6%, War Support +4%)!
strings.DEC_REICH_SS_SURVEILLANCE_DESC: Deploy Sicherheitsdienst informants to uncover treasonous cabals among government ministers and Wehrmacht brass.
strings.DEC_REICH_SS_SURVEILLANCE_LOG: Counter-intelligence grid disrupted subversion: Political Capital +25 PC, Legitimacy +5%!
strings.DEC_REICH_OSTHEER_PARADE_DESC: Stage an intimidating military review of panzer divisions to deter unrest across the eastern Reichskommissariats.
strings.DEC_REICH_OSTHEER_PARADE_LOG: Parade completed: Colonial insurgencies pacified, Reich Stability +5%!
strings.DEC_USA_CIVIL_RIGHTS_EXECUTIVE_ORDER_DES: Enact sweeping federal protections for African-American voting rights and mandate the desegregation of public facilities in southern states.
strings.DEC_USA_CIVIL_RIGHTS_EXECUTIVE_ORDER_LOG: Executive order enacted: Progressive coalitions celebrate (+10% Legitimacy), segregationist backlash flares up!
strings.DEC_USA_OFN_AIRLIFT_AFRICA_DESC: Scramble C-130 Hercules transport wings with ammunition and volunteer military advisors to defend Cape Town against the Boers and Schild.
strings.DEC_USA_OFN_AIRLIFT_AFRICA_LOG: Airlift operational: 1,500 rifles and 40 heavy equipment units delivered to South Africa!
strings.DEC_USA_CIA_OPERATION_GLADIO_DESC: Funnel untraceable funding and clandestine weapons caches to stay-behind partisan cells across occupied Europe.
strings.DEC_USA_CIA_OPERATION_GLADIO_LOG: CIA covert action authorized: Underground European resistance received clandestine financing ($80M)!
strings.DEC_USA_NASA_APOLLO_SURGE_DESC: Allocate emergency federal funding to the Apollo lunar landing program to overtake the Reich in the Moon race.
strings.DEC_USA_NASA_APOLLO_SURGE_LOG: NASA appropriations passed: American prestige elevated (+8% Legitimacy), aerospace R&D accelerated!
strings.DEC_ECON_ISSUE_WAR_BONDS_DESC: Float public war debt offerings to mobilize commercial banking capital and close fiscal deficits amid defense mobilization.
strings.DEC_ECON_ISSUE_WAR_BONDS_LOG: Bond auction concluded: Treasury replenished by +$120M, public debt modestly expanded!
strings.DEC_ECON_STRATEGIC_GRAIN_DESC: Release state grain stockpiles into wholesale commodity markets to counteract soaring food prices and suppress inflation.
strings.DEC_ECON_STRATEGIC_GRAIN_LOG: Commodity intervention complete: CPI inflation declined by 1.5%, public discontent relieved!
strings.DEC_ECON_RAISE_INTEREST_RATES_DESC: Tighten national monetary policy to cool an overheating market and stabilize currency valuations.
strings.DEC_ECON_RAISE_INTEREST_RATES_LOG: Key discount rate raised: Inflation cooled (-2.0%), domestic borrowing costs adjusted!
strings.DEC_ECON_STIMULUS_INFRASTRUCTURE_DESC: Direct public capital investment toward highway networks, communication trunklines, and grid electrification.
strings.DEC_ECON_STIMULUS_INFRASTRUCTURE_LOG: Infrastructure capital deployed: Real GDP growth accelerated (+0.8%), industrial productivity boosted!
strings.DEC_ECON_DEFENSE_PROCUREMENT_SURGE_DESC: Transition primary manufacturing plants to three-shift military schedules for expedited production of tanks and artillery.
strings.DEC_ECON_DEFENSE_PROCUREMENT_SURGE_LOG: Military procurement funded: Military factories +1, armories stocked with 2,000 firearms!
strings.DEC_MIL_LARGE_SCALE_DRILLS_DESC: Conduct combined-arms mechanized maneuvers and live-fire artillery coordination under simulated NBC warfare conditions.
strings.DEC_MIL_LARGE_SCALE_DRILLS_LOG: Maneuvers concluded: Army combat readiness elevated by 7%, military morale fortified (+5%)!
strings.DEC_MIL_CONSCRIPTION_EXPANSION_DESC: Mobilize draft classes and deploy fast-track training curricula across regional military academies.
strings.DEC_MIL_CONSCRIPTION_EXPANSION_LOG: Induction centers processed recruits: +12,000 conscripts mobilized to reserve battalions!
strings.DEC_DIPLO_FOREIGN_AID_MISSION_TITLE: Foreign Aid Mission to Non-Aligned States
strings.DEC_DIPLO_FOREIGN_AID_MISSION_DESC: Dispatch food shipments, pharmaceuticals, and development credits to unaligned developing nations to contest foreign influence.
strings.DEC_DIPLO_FOREIGN_AID_MISSION_LOG: Diplomatic aid tranches delivered: Sovereign international prestige and coalition sway increased!
strings.DEC_DIPLO_BORDER_FORTIFICATION_DESC: Construct concrete bunker redoubts, extensive minefields, and anti-tank ditching along vulnerable international boundaries.
strings.DEC_DIPLO_BORDER_FORTIFICATION_LOG: Fortified defense line established: Frontier defense readiness reinforced by +8%!
strings.DEC_STATE_ANTI_CORRUPTION_PURGE_DESC: Order surprise inspections of supply logistics networks and convene tribunals to try embezzlers of state ordnance.
strings.DEC_STATE_ANTI_CORRUPTION_PURGE_LOG: State auditors uncovered illicit caches: 1,200 rifles returned to depots, Regime Legitimacy +8%!
strings.DEC_STATE_BLACK_BUDGET_COVERT_DESC: Channel off-the-books treasury disbursements into foreign intelligence accounts to execute clandestine special operations.
strings.DEC_STATE_BLACK_BUDGET_COVERT_LOG: Black budget enriched: Foreign station intelligence networks secured expansive operational reserves!
strings.DEC_STATE_EMERGENCY_DECREE_CURFEW_DESC: Impose armed military street patrols and ban unsanctioned public assemblies to crush street riots and extremist agitators.
strings.DEC_STATE_EMERGENCY_DECREE_CURFEW_LOG: Martial curfew enforced: Streets pacified and agitators detained (Radicalization -10%, Legitimacy -4%)!
